title: Event bookings, travel time and quoting for makeup work
audience: Mobile makeup artists who take bookings for events, shoots and bridal work
learningOutcomes: Build a quote that shows the service, the trial session, travel time and any kit fees
Write a cancellation and rescheduling term the client can read before paying
Decide when a booking needs a second artist or a different price

instruction.heading: What a quote must show
instruction.body: A makeup quote shows the service, the number of people, the time on site, the travel time and any kit or product fee, as separate lines. A trial session is priced separately because it takes time and product. Clients who have not seen the price breakdown often ask for items that were never offered, so the quote lists what is included and what is extra.

instruction.heading: Travel and time on site
instruction.body: Travel time to a venue is part of the working day. Quote it as its own line, using the pricing method the business has set. A booking that runs past its time needs a stated rule for the extra time, agreed before the event. Do not promise a set finish time that depends on the client getting ready.

instruction.heading: Cancellation and rescheduling
instruction.body: Write the cancellation term in the quote, in plain words, with the date and amount that apply. The term should say what happens if the client cancels, reschedules or does not arrive. Terms that the local consumer law does not allow are not used. procedure: Confirm the date, venue, number of people and start time before quoting
List the services, trial session, travel time and any kit fee as separate lines
State what is included and what is extra, in plain words
Set the cancellation and rescheduling terms and show them before the deposit is taken
Record the agreed quote and any changes in writing before the day

workedExamples.situation: A client wants a bridal party of four at a venue 40 minutes away, with a trial the week before. She asks for one price that covers everything.
workedExamples.decisionPrompt: How should the quote be built?
workedExamples.reasoning: The artist lists each service, the trial, the travel time to the venue and any kit fee on separate lines. The start time and the rule for extra time are written down. A single total is only given if the lines still show what it includes.

equipmentAndPpe: Pricing sheet with the business pricing method
Travel log or route estimate for the venue

commonErrors.error: Quoting one total with no breakdown.
commonErrors.prevention: Show each service and fee as a line so the client knows what they are buying.
Quote travel time as its own line using the business pricing method.

commonErrors.error: Agreeing to a finish time that depends on other people.
commonErrors.prevention: Quote the time on site and the rule for extra time instead.

safetyAndRegulatory.point: Cancellation and deposit terms must follow the consumer law that applies where the business operates. UNCONFIRMED: no official source has been fetched for this point in this draft. A reviewer must confirm it before approval.

qualityStandard: Every quote lists services, trial, travel and fees as separate lines
Cancellation terms are shown before a deposit is taken
Changes to a booking are confirmed in writing
documentationEvidence: Signed or confirmed quote with line items
Booking record with date, venue and start time
summary: A quote shows each service, fee and travel time as separate lines
Trials and kit fees are priced separately
Cancellation terms are written and shown before payment

knowledgeChecks.question: A client asks for one price for a bridal party with a trial and travel. What should the quote do?
options: Give one total with no breakdown
Show each service, the trial, travel and any kit fee as separate lines
Leave travel off and add it on the day

knowledgeChecks.question: Why should a cancellation term be shown before a deposit is taken?
options: It is not needed if the client has paid
So the client knows the terms they are agreeing to
Because it removes the need for a written quote

knowledgeChecks.question: A client asks the artist to promise the event finish time. What is the right response?
options: Promise it to secure the booking
Quote the time on site and state the rule for extra time
